'''Ratbats''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that lived on [[Despayre]],<ref name="DS" /> a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> The ratbats were caught by the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] working on the surface of Despayre and roasted, contributing to their meager [[Diet/Legends|diet]]. All the ratbats on Despayre [[Death/Legends|perished]] with the [[Destruction of Despayre|destruction]] of the planet by the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]<ref name="DS" /> that occurred in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' places the [[attack on the first Death Star]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. The attack on the first Death Star appears in the novel [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']] and takes place before the [[Destruction of Despayre]]. Since the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] was destroyed in 0 BBY according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the Destruction of Despayre must have also occurred in 0 BBY.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ratbats were created by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] in their [[2007]] novel [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']].<ref name="DS" />
